scope: Bottom-13 of the 12m ranking at first read: BAJFINANCE TATACAP BAJAJFINSV PERSISTENT ETERNAL PRESTIGE JIOFIN LENSKART YESBANK MEESHO TCS AUBANK TECHM. Re-checked against rankings.csv of 08:44 UTC (after the RT_BACKBONE, RT_EVENTS, RT_TOP, RT_N50, RT_BOT_B and DIRECTOR_CE merges).
method: Decomposed forward exposure by the final company edge and by entry node. Computed the implied expected forward moves of repo, 10y, VIX and S&P. Checked edges against the empirical pack and against prices on the 7-8 Oct hike days. Fetched news for Q2 results, AT1, ECL scope, IT visa and MSCI. Re-ran mi/graph.run with every proposal below on a scratch output directory; results/ was not touched. 12m ER before -> after, from the simulation (excluding the unpriced-rule and catalogue-skew proposals): BAJFINANCE -7.4 -> -2.3, TATACAP -6.5 -> -2.8, BAJAJFINSV -6.1 -> -1.9, JIOFIN -5.5 -> -2.2, YESBANK -5.8 -> -4.1, ETERNAL -4.7 -> -2.8, LENSKART -4.2 -> -1.4, AUBANK -3.9 -> -2.7, PRESTIGE -2.2 -> -0.6, MEESHO -2.1 -> 0.1, PERSISTENT -4.5 -> -5.0, TCS -2.5 -> -3.0, TECHM -2.4 -> -2.9 (IT moves down through centring).

edge_scale.reason: Profile's own arithmetic gives -1.2 (Rs376cr floating-funding cost + rollover = -2.5% EBT x persistence 0.5). The mechanism then adds 'P/E de-rating at 34x' to reach -3. That multiple channel is already the F_GSEC_10Y_IN edge (-2.5, 'cost of equity at P/E 34x') and the REPO -> GSEC (0.53) -> BAJFINANCE path. Keep the fundamental -1.2. Evidence: on 7-8 Oct (hike to 5.50%) BAJFINANCE fell -0.7% against Nifty -2.4%.

Mechanism computes -0.8 (Rs860cr = -3.2% PBT, 50% pass-through, persistence 0.5). It then lifts this to -5 for a 'multiple effect', which is the same discount-rate channel as the GSEC edge. 0.4 gives -2.0, still 2.5x the arithmetic.

Empirical market-adjusted elasticity +0.01 per +5 VIX (t 0.04, 156 weeks, results/empirical_sensitivities.csv). The -2 is market beta, which the beta adjustment already removes. Forward catalogue VIX expectation is +1.5 SSU, so this edge alone books about -2.8 pp of forward exposure.

Own arithmetic is -0.8 (Rs330cr = -3.3% PBT, half re-priced through floating LAP/corporate/EBLR assets, persistence 0.5). The 'P/E 24.5x multiple effect' that lifts it to -3 duplicates the GSEC edge (-2.5) and the REPO->GSEC path. Q2 FY27 PAT rose 51% to Rs1,660cr and the stock gained 5% (ET 27-28 Oct).
+50bp on Rs0.96 lakh cr = Rs480cr = 4.8% PBT, 50% passed through, persistence 0.5 gives -1.2. The -4 includes a multiple add-on already carried by the GSEC edge. 0.5 gives -2.
Look-through of BAJFINANCE's inflated -3 (x0.75). It is scaled with the BAJFINANCE fix; insurance float gains from higher yields offset further.
Look-through of BAJFINANCE -5 (x0.8). It inherits the same multiple double count, so it gets the same scale as BAJFINANCE (0.4).
Empirical market-adjusted elasticity -0.18 per +5 VIX (t -0.58). The -2 restates beta 1.06-1.14.

Mechanism: '+5 VIX ~ Nifty -3.5%; beta 1.47-1.57 ... -> -5'. This is market beta and is double counted with the beta adjustment. Empirical market-adjusted elasticity is +0.11 (t 0.26). The edge was the largest single forward channel (EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK -16.9% conditional for JIOFIN). -1 keeps a small growth-duration premium.
Own arithmetic -1.5 (NIM -6bp on Rs2.9 lakh cr, persistence 0.5). The mechanism 'doubled for discount-rate effect', which is the GSEC edge plus the REPO->GSEC path.

The mechanism books AFS MTM (Rs250cr) as a P&L hit. Under RBI's 2023 investment-portfolio directions (effective Apr 2024; model knowledge), AFS unrealised losses go to the AFS reserve in equity, not P&L. The remaining channels are a small CET1 effect and discount rate.

Own arithmetic -0.9 (net -Rs77cr = -1.8% PBT, persistence 0.5), plus a 'P/E 22x multiple effect' that duplicates the GSEC edge and path. Kept at -1.5 because the Q2 call (24 Oct) flagged margin pressure. The stock fell 8-10% on 26 Oct, and that move is in the realised return.

Mechanism splits -4 into PAT -2.0, demand -0.6 and multiple -1.4. Demand is the separate REPO -> F_HOUSING_DEMAND (-0.26) -> PRESTIGE (+5) path. The multiple is the GSEC edge (-1.0, cap rates and resi discounting) plus the REPO->GSEC path. Keep about -2.4.

Discount-rate channel (P/E ~700, Gordon 0.25/(r-g)) applies the full 25bp to a 25-year duration. Long yields move about 0.53x repo (backbone REPO->GSEC edge), so the duration effect belongs to the long rate. The forward catalogue's +62bp repo path (see findings) makes this edge -6 pp of forward exposure.
Empirical market-adjusted elasticity +0.67 per +5 VIX (t 1.15, wrong sign). The profile's -2.5 is mostly beta (1.1-1.3).

Contradicted by the profile's own data: FII holding rose 29.1% -> 33.0% (Jun-Sep 2026) during the record FPI outflow, and the stock is +39% market-adjusted since June. A broad-flow beta of +3.5 books -5.6% of 'unpriced' recent impact that did not happen.
Same as ETERNAL: Gordon duration on a 25bp short-rate move. Long-rate beta to repo is about 0.53.
No empirical history (listed Nov 2025). -3 'after market component' is not supported; peer ETERNAL's empirical value is +0.67. Halved.

FII holding rose 4.3% -> 18.3% in two quarters while aggregate FPI flows were at a record outflow. Stock-level flows are block supply from pre-IPO holders, not the macro FPI node. The stock is at an all-time high (+11% on 5 Nov after Q2).
Same duration logic as ETERNAL/LENSKART. Long-rate beta to repo is about 0.53.
-4 'after market component' has no empirical support (listed Dec 2025). Peer ETERNAL's empirical value is +0.67. Halved.

Output-gap reaction edge (0.8 SSU = 20bp per 1pp GDP). Summed over about 90 independent forward events, it turns good-growth news hawkish. EV_MONSOON27_FIRST_FORECAST_NORMAL adds +0.26 SSU expected repo, although a normal monsoon lowers food inflation. EV_BUDGET27_CAPEX_RAILWAY adds +0.31 SSU. Propagated repo moves total +1.35 SSU of the catalogue's +2.46 SSU (+62bp) 12m expectation, against +0.59 SSU from the explicit MPC events. The explicit Dec/Feb/Apr MPC odds (RT_EVENTS) already condition on growth and inflation. This is the same treatment RT_BACKBONE gave CPI->REPO (x0.5): RT_BACKBONE did not cover this edge, so there is no duplicate.

findings.subject: F_REPO_IN forward path (all rate-sensitive names)
findings.issue: Rate channel double counted across forward events. Even after RT_BACKBONE's CPI->REPO x0.5, the catalogue implies an expected +2.46 SSU (+62bp) repo move over 12m, on top of the 7 Oct hike. The explicit MPC events (Dec 0.42, Feb 0.27, Apr cut 0.10) give only +0.59 SSU (+15bp). Explicit repo shocks inside other events add +0.52 (CPI breach 0.24, rupee break, stagflation). Propagation through CPI->REPO and GDP->REPO adds +1.35, including +0.26 from a NORMAL monsoon forecast (GDP->REPO dominates the food-disinflation path) and +0.31 from budget capex. The expected 10y G-sec move is +1.91 SSU (+48bp). Street forecasts are flat to lower: 7.25-7.35% for November (ET BFSI 4 Nov; Bandhan AMC 7-7.5%) and 6.75-7.0% by March per SBI Research (BS 1 Nov). RBI minutes (Reuters 21 Oct) flag more hikes but are 'wary of an aggressive cycle'. F_REPO_IN was the largest final edge in forward exposure for BAJFINANCE (-6.2 pp), TATACAP (-6.3), YESBANK, AUBANK, PRESTIGE and ETERNAL. Fixes here: GDP->REPO x0.4 and REPO clamps in EV_CPI_BREACH_6PCT and EV_PULSES_VEG_SPIKE_WINTER. Preferred engine fix for the Director: clamp F_REPO_IN in every non-RBI forward event dated before the last explicit MPC event (Apr 2027), so the MPC odds alone carry the policy path.
findings.evidence: results/event_impacts.csv; results/edges_all.csv; https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=India+10-year+bond+yield+November+2026+when:10d&hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN:en; https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=RBI+MPC+minutes+October+2026+further+tightening+when:30d&hl=en-IN&gl=IN&ceid=IN:en

findings.subject: EV_ECL_ROLLOUT_APR27 -> NBFCs
findings.issue: The bank ECL rollout is routed through generic nodes, so it hits NBFCs that are outside the 27 Apr 2026 directions: BAJFINANCE -1.98, TATACAP -2.41, JIOFIN -1.08, BAJAJFINSV -1.67 conditional at p 0.9. NBFCs have applied Ind AS 109 ECL since FY2018 with no regulatory floor, and BFL's coverage of 2.0% already exceeds the bank-floor-equivalent 1.2% (Kotak via ETBFSI). I add offsets via company_event_overrides.add for my four NBFCs, because RT_EVENTS owns the event override and an event_overrides entry would conflict. The cleaner universal fix is a bank-only node for ECL.

findings.subject: Forward catalogue global-risk skew (IT and high-beta names)
findings.issue: Summed over forward events, the expected 12m moves are F_US_EQUITIES -1.95 SSU (S&P -9.75%) and F_RISK_SENTIMENT +1.49 SSU (VIX +7.5 pts). They come from EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK, EV_US_RECESSION_RISK_2027 and EV_YEN_CARRY_UNWIND_RISK, with no upside counterpart (only EV_NVDA_NOV17_BEAT, +0.4 SSU S&P). After my fixes, and once the financials' rate artefacts shrink, this skew is what keeps PERSISTENT/TCS/TECHM (and INFY, HCLTECH, LTM, MPHASIS, WIPRO) in the bottom 15. Their US_EQUITIES edges match the empirical pack (+1.07 to +2.15), so the edges are fine and the expectation is skewed. Recommend that the Director/RT_EVENTS add a balancing upside scenario (AI-capex re-acceleration / soft landing, S&P +3 SSU, VIX -1.5 SSU) or demean global risk nodes across the catalogue. Not submitted as an override because it is a catalogue-design choice.
findings.evidence: results/event_impacts.csv; events/global_macro.json

findings.subject: Unpriced-recent rule, opposite-sign cases (cross-reference RT_BOT_B)
findings.issue: Agree with RT_BOT_B's universe finding (model recent impact vs realised: Pearson -0.33). In my names the rule keeps the full model impact as 'unpriced' when the stock moved the other way. BAJFINANCE: model -10.0 beta-adjusted vs realised +14.3. TATACAP: -9.7 vs +9.7. Also PRESTIGE (-7.1 vs +12.6), PERSISTENT, TCS, TECHM and MEESHO. NBFCs as a group outperformed through the hike (CHOLAFIN +12.3, TATACAP +9.7, BAJFINANCE +14.3 market-adjusted), which points to overstated sensitivity, not a pending hit. My edge fixes cut BAJFINANCE's unpriced part from -8.9 to -5.7. Engine-level proposal: when sign(realised) != sign(model) and |realised| > |model|, cap the unpriced share at 0.5 x model unless a dated stock-specific event of matching size is documented. This is not in my simulated numbers.
findings.evidence: results/rankings.csv; review/RT_BOT_B.json
